_doc: Projects the release-cut lane cuts (rules: ~/.local/src/docs/stages.md, Release windows, Cut). cut_hour: the local time a window with no cut= is cut on its due day. tests: the full run a cut needs green on main. cut_inputs: path prefixes the cut workflow checks out from main besides its own file (its sparse-checkout); a change under one since a failed cut run sends the cut again at the same commit. promote: for each tag of the newest cut (the version's, and one per game), once its newest deployment to an environment ending in deployment_suffix (<target><suffix>) succeeds, the lane files this item once ({tag}, {build} and {target} filled in); a target whose deployment failed gets none.

promote.item: release(steam): set {tag}'s beta build {build} live on Steam default through store-console on the agent machine, after checking whether the app is publicly released and recording the BuildID it replaces (release.md, Who takes the public step)
